items.how: RBI CoR; financial assets and income test.
steps: Obtain the RBI certificate of registration
items.text: Certificate of registration held for the category of NBFC; principal business criteria met.

steps: Compare with the minimum for the layer
items.text: Net owned fund and capital adequacy meet the minimum for the layer and category.

steps: Check asset classification and provisioning against RBI norms
items.text: Assets classified and provisioned as per RBI norms; NPAs identified on time.

steps: Check STR / CTR filings with FIU-IND
items.text: KYC done for borrowers; suspicious and cash transaction reports filed with FIU-IND.

steps: List matters required in the RBI directions report
Draft the report to the board
items.text: Separate report to the board on matters required by RBI directions prepared.
Periodic returns to RBI filed on time.

items.ref: SEBI regulations for the intermediary (e.g. Stock Brokers Regulations 1992)
steps: If a SEBI intermediary, reconcile client funds and securities
items.text: Client funds and securities segregated; net worth and periodic reporting as required (if a SEBI intermediary).
